thread:
Ben: Quick sync — we need final X & LinkedIn schedule + assets for Wed launch. Priorities: benchmark thread, webinar promo, and post-launch engagement follow-ups. Putting goals in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/... (please add asset links)
Alice: Got it. I'll own messaging iteration. Ben, can you sync on the benchmark narrative? We should highlight latency/cost wins and RT comparisons :bar_chart:
Carla: I can do creative. Need final headline and 2 image sizes by EOD tomorrow. Any visual refs?
Ben: Headline draft in the sheet. Short X thread (6 tweets) + 1 long-form LinkedIn. CTA: webinar sign-up or demo. Use this short headline: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency & cost — Redwood Inference"
Evan: For amplification, can we add a small paid boost to the key LinkedIn post? Budget 1k. Target: platform engineers + infra leads.
Maya: On inbound routing — confirm the signup form hits our webinar funnel. If yes, routing to SF via Segment + tag source=linkedin/x-launch
Ben: Yes. Webinar form -> /webinar-signup -> Segment track('webinar_signup', {source}) -> SF lead creation. Carla, include UTM params in asset links.
Carla: Cool. For images: do we want product UI screenshots or conceptual art? I vote UI screenshots showing console metrics.
Alice: UI screenshots + a hero with product + tagline. Also include a short gif (500KB) for X.
Ben: Copy variants: (A) short X-friendly bullets, (B) thread intros, (C) LinkedIn long-form. I'll drop examples in the sheet.
Ben: Sample X thread starter: "Latency matters. Cost matters. Here's how we dropped per-token cost 3.2x while keeping latency under 50ms — a look at our serving optimizations.👇"
Alice: Nice. Keep language concrete. Add a callout line about fallback policies. Also mention Dedicated & Private options briefly.
Evan: I'll prep the paid amplification audience. Need final post time — recommend Wed 11am PT for LinkedIn, 12pm PT thread on X.
Maya: Ops checklist for launch day: 1) confirm webhook to CRM 2) monitor traffic spike 3) scale rules for Dedicated pools 4) Slack alert channel #launch-monitoring
DevBot: Reminder set for Wed 10:30 PT to run preflight checklist.
Carla: I'll upload hero + screenshots + gif to the drive folder by tomorrow 4pm. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fakefolder
Ben: After assets, can someone run a quick A/B test on the LinkedIn headline vs. variant B? Small sample via paid boost.
Alice: I'll run A/B. Evan will manage the boost. Carla please export two headline versions as PNG overlays.
Evan: Confirmed. Budget allocated.
Maya: Routing note — tag leads with campaign=launch_apr_wed and source channel.
Ben: Thanks all. I'll collate final copy and post schedule here by EOD. Let's keep replies in this thread for any last-minute updates :rocket:
Alice: One more — post-launch follow-up cadence: immediate thank-you DM + 3-touch nurture over 2 weeks. I'll draft nurture copy.
Carla: Uploaded hero v1 and screenshots. Feedback welcome.
Ben: Looks great. Small tweak on hero tagline — move "predictable" earlier. I'll edit and re-upload.
DevBot: Countdown: 1 day until preflight reminder.
